news.headline: Tenax at Cantor Conference: Trial Miss Sharpens Next-Step Strategy
news.summary: At the 12th Annual Cantor Fitzgerald Global Healthcare Conference, CEO Chris Giordano argued the LEVEL trial miss was a lesson in patient selection rather than a verdict on levosimendan, pointing to strong biomarker and subgroup effects as the basis for an enriched LEVEL-2 path. Shares rose about 9-10% on the appearance.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics, Inc. Given Consensus Rating of "Hold" by Brokerages
news.summary: With 10 analysts now covering the stock (1 sell, 5 hold, 3 buy, 1 strong buy), the post-LEVEL-miss analyst shakeout settled into a consensus "Hold," down from a "Moderate Buy" average in mid-August. Average price targets still imply substantial upside from the roughly $2 share price.

news.headline: ADAR1 Capital Management, 10% Owner, Buys $1.6M More in Tenax Therapeutics
news.summary: Daniel Schneeberger's ADAR1 Capital Management purchased roughly 900,000 more TENX shares on Sept 3 at $1.78-$1.80, following smaller buys on Sept 1-2, lifting its indirect stake to about 6,524,151 shares (roughly 14-15%). This continues a near-uninterrupted open-market buying streak dating to Aug 20.

news.headline: Guggenheim Downgrades TENX to Neutral Amid Uncertain Clinical Outcomes
news.summary: Guggenheim cut Tenax to Neutral from Buy and lowered its price target to $4, citing continued clinical and regulatory uncertainty for TNX-103 even after the fuller ESC Congress dataset was released.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Presentation of Phase 3 LEVEL Results in Late-Breaking Scientific Sessions at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Northwestern's Dr. Sanjiv Shah presented the complete LEVEL dataset as a late-breaker, confirming a favorable treatment effect in the prespecified subgroup with lower baseline 6-minute walk distance, alongside consistent biomarker and pulmonary-hemodynamic improvements across the trial.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Topline Results from Phase 3 LEVEL Clinical Trial of TNX-103 in Patients with PH-HFpEF
news.summary: The Phase 3 LEVEL trial missed its primary 6-minute walk distance endpoint and key secondary KCCQ endpoint, sending shares down roughly 87-90%. Tenax said it will request an FDA Type C meeting and EMA scientific advice to pursue an enriched registrational strategy targeting patients with lower baseline walk distance.

catalysts.label: FDA Type C meeting on levosimendan path forward
catalysts.detail: Requested meeting to discuss the complete LEVEL dataset and an enriched registrational path for LEVEL-2, leaning on the subgroup and biomarker data presented at ESC; no meeting date has been publicly confirmed as of September 10.

catalysts.label: Parallel EMA scientific advice
catalysts.detail: Tenax also intends to seek parallel scientific consultation from the EMA on the enrichment strategy alongside the FDA Type C meeting.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and cash-runway/strategy update
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report should update the cash position (guided to a runway through Q2 2028 as of June 30, 2026) and give concrete next steps for the levosimendan program, including any outcome from the FDA Type C meeting. Third-party trackers estimate mid/late November; not yet confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 Phase 3 enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, roughly 540-patient LEVEL-2 registrational trial (NCT07288398, 2:1 randomization) remains ongoing, targeting the enriched lower-baseline-walk-distance population highlighted at ESC, with enrollment completion guided to end of 2027.

pulse: Six weeks after LEVEL missed its primary endpoint, Tenax has stabilized around $2/share as CEO Chris Giordano reframes the miss as a patient-selection issue, backed by the ESC Congress late-breaker's confirmed subgroup benefit and biomarker signal in patients with lower baseline walk distance. ADAR1 Capital's Daniel Schneeberger kept buying almost daily through early September, pushing his stake to roughly 14-15% (~6.5 million shares), even as Wall Street's consensus settled to 'Hold' (Guggenheim cut to Neutral, $4 target) pending regulatory clarity. The key overhang remains the still-unscheduled FDA Type C meeting on an enriched LEVEL-2 path; no meeting date or other material news has emerged since September 9.
